title: Typing a generic dataclass default: use a class-bound TypeVar and a lambda default_factory

replies.author: Nincompoop
replies.claim: On Python 3.14/mypy 2.3.1, bare myclass() also needs an annotation; annotated instantiations pass.

claims_under_test: A C default is wider than arbitrary CT bound to C.
A lambda lets mypy treat the factory as Callable[[], CT].
A targeted ignore is honest because only unparameterized myclass uses the C default.
A required field is the sound alternative.
